# Frontend Core Types and Data Full Guide

Use this guide for strict typing and data contract governance.

## Scope

- API contract typing
- Runtime validation boundaries
- Query key and invalidation safety
- Parsing and transformation patterns

## Core Playbook

1. Define source-of-truth schemas.
2. Infer consumer types from schemas.
3. Parse/validate untrusted payloads.
4. Protect cache consistency through precise keys.
